description: A professional certification or license held by the user.

main.description: Record representing a single certification or license.

authorityDid.description: DID of the issuing authority's ATproto account, if one exists.

entityRef.description: Portable, app-neutral identifier for the issuing organization the user selected from a resolver dropdown: a Wikidata Q-ID URI (http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q...), a ROR URI, or an LEI URI. Enables deterministic resolution to a canonical entity even before the organization claims an ATproto account. Absent for free-text entries.

agentRef.description: The issuing authority, as a single nested reference mirroring the flat authority / authorityDid / entityRef fields. Additive dual-write: the flat fields remain the source of truth for existing consumers.

issuedAt.description: Date the certification was issued, in YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD format.

expiresAt.description: Expiry date in YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD format. Omit if the certification does not expire.

labels.description: Self-label values for this certification record.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this record was originally created.
